hazard_or_failure: Heat from the controller inside the enclosure warms the temperature sensor
effect: Temperature reads high; humidity reads low
controls: Keep the sensor away from the controller and outside or vented from the enclosure
verified_by: TP-002 step 3 (warm-up rise at most 2 °C) / REQ-003

hazard_or_failure: Lab Wi-Fi drops or the unit loses its connection
Power is cut while the unit is writing data
controls: Design tolerates power cuts (e.g. read-only or journalled storage); test with power cuts

hazard_or_failure: A chosen part is out of stock or slow to ship
effect: Order this week slips; iteration 1 misses 2026-11-30
controls: Choose parts that are in stock at the supplier; check stock at G2

hazard_or_failure: Wiring mistake during assembly (wrong connector or reversed power)
effect: A board is damaged or a sensor does not respond
controls: Keyed connectors where possible; assembly instructions; inspection check before power-up
verified_by: Assembly instruction step checks 2 (SHIM pin 1 over the square pad) and 5 (cables latched) before power-up at step 7

hazard_or_failure: Wi-Fi password committed to the public repo
controls: Credentials entered on each unit; never stored in the repo

hazard_or_failure: No reference instrument is available to check accuracy
effect: REQ-003 cannot be verified at G3
controls: Closed 2026-11-24: REQ-003 no longer needs a reference instrument (response test and weather station); REQ-013 compares the two units

hazard_or_failure: Wall power supply overheats or fails
effect: Unit stops; minor burn or fire risk
controls: Buy a certified supply (CSA or UL listed) from a known supplier
verified_by: REQ-005 (A04 first-unit check: UL or CSA mark)

hazard_or_failure: Server is unreachable for a while
effect: Readings from that period are lost
controls: Accepted: recovering lost readings is out of scope (plan.yaml); the unit resumes sending when the server returns

effect: Timestamps are wrong and readings cannot be linked to other experiments
controls: Unit syncs time from the network and flags readings taken before a sync

hazard_or_failure: Unit cannot join the lab Wi-Fi (enterprise login) or reach the server
effect: No readings reach the server; REQ-004 fails at G3
controls: Choose a controller that supports enterprise Wi-Fi login or Tailscale; confirm device onboarding with lab IT before G2

hazard_or_failure: Lab vapours or dust make the sensors drift over time
controls: Sensors open to air but away from fume sources; REQ-013 comparison repeated when units are moved

hazard_or_failure: Enclosure blocks airflow to the VOC sensor
effect: VOC index responds slowly or not at all
controls: Vents next to the VOC sensor (ECR-002; replaces the ECR-001 light-sensor risk)

hazard_or_failure: Someone relies on the VOC reading as a safety alarm
controls: Unit is labelled as monitoring only and not a certified alarm (REQ-015)
